_comment: Custom badge data for the BadgeAPI plugin, served straight from this repo.
To add a badge to someone, append its id to their array in `users` below.
To create a new kind of badge, add an entry to `badges` below.
Each badge needs a `label` and an `icon`, which is a path in this repo,
e.g. "badges/dev.png" (resolved against the repo). It can also have:
`link`   - opened when the badge is clicked
